texts.li: [summer] All afternoon {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} sat in the colony's shade, waiting for the yard to empty. When it did, {X_nameDef} beckoned {A_nameDef} over and unfolded a map with a mark on the colony's own land.\n\nToo hot to dig, {X_nameDef} says, and too far from home. {COUNT} silver and the map is the colony's.

[colony:Thrifty] A colony that likes a bargain should hear this one, says {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, and offers {A_nameDef} a map to a cache buried on the colony's own land, for {COUNT} silver. {A_nameDef} has asked to hold it up to the light first.

lines.li: {X_nameDef} takes the silver and hands the map over with both hands, like something precious. {A_nameDef} has already found the spot on the land it points to.

riskLines.li: {A_nameDef} holds the map against the land, and the marks match nothing: not the hills, not the stream, not the old road. The silver is gone.

lines.li: {X_nameDef} tucks the map back into {X_possessive} coat and says somebody else will be rich instead.

riskLines.li: {B_nameDef} found the mark had been drawn over a copy of a real map, with the real cache scratched out. {X_nameDef} says it was a joke. The silver stays home.

texts.li: [winter] {ENEMY} are hungry this winter, and someone has decided the colony will feed them. Their messenger came through the snow with the price: {COUNT} silver. If it isn't paid, {ENEMY} will come and take it, and whatever else they find.
[colony:Walled] {ENEMY} have looked at the colony's walls and decided silver is easier to take than a gate. Their messenger named it: {COUNT} silver, or a war party to collect it.

lines.li: The silver is carried to the gate and left for {ENEMY} to collect. The colony goes back to work, and nobody talks much at supper.
[colony:Harsh] The colony pays, this once, and hates it. The silver goes out to the gate for {ENEMY} to collect.
{A_nameDef} names the colony's lean months, one by one, until {ENEMY} take half and call it settled. Half goes out to the gate.

riskLines.li: {A_nameDef} laughed at the price, and {ENEMY} heard the laugh. The tribute is off the table. A war party is on its way instead.

lines.li: The colony sends back one word, and spends the rest of the day getting ready for what that word costs.
Hands are shaken on the stake in front of witnesses, and {A_nameDef} goes off to get ready. The match is a couple of hours off.
No silver, just the name of the winner, says {X_nameDef}, and that's the bit that lasts. The match starts in a couple of hours.
[colony:Traditional] A contest for honor, the way it was always done. The match starts in a couple of hours, and the old ones are already arguing about who will win.
The cargo goes back to {FACTION}, every piece of it, with a note saying where it was found. {FACTION} will remember the colony for it.
The cargo stays where the colony put it. When {FACTION} ask after it, they get no answer, and they draw their own conclusions.
{A_nameDef} goes with a bag over one shoulder and doesn't make a speech. {FACTION}'s silver comes in {A_possessive} place, and sits where it was left until supper.
{A_nameDef} thinks it over and decides to stay. "Ask me again in ten years," is the word {A_nameDef} sends back to {FACTION}.

riskLines.li: {A_nameDef} thinks it over and says yes. There's a goodbye for everyone in turn, and then {A_nameDef} is gone down the road.

lines.li: {X_nameDef} asks about everything, the food and the quarrels and the dead, and writes down the answers in a small fast hand. The colony will be read about.
[lowtech] {X_nameDef} listens to anyone who will talk and writes it all down on long strips of bark. The colony's story will be told in other halls.
{X_nameDef} is shown the road. A colony that won't talk, {X_nameDef} says, is a story too.

riskLines.li: {A_nameDef} got onto the subject of the colony's quarrels and couldn't get off it. {X_nameDef} filled three pages, and the piece will make the colony sound like a kennel.

lines.li: {X_nameDef} goes from person to person with the case open, and even the ones who hide get found. The doses are given, and the silver is paid.
[lowtech] {X_nameDef} gives every colonist a cup of something bitter and stands there until they drink it. The silver goes into {X_possessive} pouch.
{X_nameDef} snaps the case shut, says the colony knows where to find {X_objective}, and goes on to the next settlement.
